description: States the alpha_EM 1/pi wall as a precise two-clause conjecture (A: per-mode weight = universal heat-kernel unit a0=|chi|/(2*Area); B: multiplicity = 2 = Hecke channels) and machine-checks the exact skeleton: GB identity all-genus (b1 only at g=4), McKean-Singer constant chi/6=-1 on Bring, multiplicity discriminant m=2. Clauses A+B stay conjectural (the wall). Dilog implication runs dilog->wall, not conversely. Nothing wired.

assertions.name: gb_identity_all_genus_b1_only_g4
assertions.detail: |chi|/(4*Area) - 1/(8pi) == 0 identically in g (Area=2pi|chi|), while 1/(pi*b1)=1/(8pi) has unique solution g=[4] — corroborates main's GB adjudication (ba606720e): the measure is a (chi,Area) invariant; b1 is a g=4 coincidence

assertions.name: mckean_singer_constant_term_bring_minus1
assertions.detail: Seeley-DeWitt a1 = IntK/(12pi) = chi/6 (McKean-Singer 1967); Bring (g=4, chi=-6) gives heat-trace constant term EXACTLY -1 — the unique-S5 genus-4 curve sits at the integer anchor of the a1 coefficient

assertions.name: multiplicity_discriminant_m2_not_b1
assertions.detail: measure = 1/(m*4pi) matches the working 1/(8pi) iff m=2 (m=b1=8 would give 1/(32pi), ~4x off, excluded by the merged D*=8.003 forcedness). m=2 is DATA-selected; Clause B (m=2 == the two Hecke channels e+/e-) is the open derivation — this is a scope-(a) statement, not a derivation

result.conjecture: measure = (1/2)*a0; A: a0 = 1/(4pi) = |chi|/(2*Area) universal; B: multiplicity = 2 = Hecke channels (e+, e-)
result.dilog_implication: wall does NOT imply conj:dilogarithm-archimedean-limit (R3 consumes dilog as input)
result.verdict: PER-LOOP WALL STATED AS A PRECISE TWO-CLAUSE CONJECTURE (scope-(a); no fit, nothing wired, 1/(8pi) stays phase-4): measure = (1/2)*a0 with Clause A (per-mode weight = universal heat-kernel unit a0 = 1/(4pi) = |chi|/(2*Area), GB-geometrized) and Clause B (multiplicity EXACTLY 2 = the Hecke channels e+/e-). Machine-checked skeleton: the GB identity holds for ALL genus (b1 reading only at g=4, corroborating main's adjudication); the McKean-Singer heat-trace constant is chi/6 = -1 EXACTLY on Bring; the multiplicity discriminant selects m=2 (m=b1 excluded ~4x). Clauses A and B remain CONJECTURAL — they are the wall. IMPLICATION: proving them does NOT prove conj:dilogarithm-archimedean-limit (R3 consumes the dilog as input; arrow runs dilog->wall). NO tier change.
